# AutoAccept

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** AutoAccept, AutoTPaccept

## What it does

Automatically accept tpa requests and duel requests

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/AutoAccept.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
